source.title: Armagh Guardian, 21 May 1964, p. 1 (report of the nominations: "There were no nominations for two seats held by Nationalists on Armagh Rural Council")
source.publisher: Armagh Guardian (via the British Newspaper Archive)
source.check: both names and divisions read from the page image; no nomination, outgoing member deemed re-elected, no poll

note: Triennial election of the rural district council (31 divisions), 1964: the only contest was Glenaul. No nomination was received for Corporation West or Lisnadill, where the outgoing members were deemed re-elected. Returned unopposed. No nomination was received; the outgoing member was deemed re-elected ("if he and Mr. Arthur Patrick O'Toole Largey of Lisnadill agree, they will be returned": Armagh Guardian, 21 May 1964, p. 1). The Portadown News (22 May 1964, p. 5) also prints "No nomination" for the division.
